def compute(group):
    start = group.loc[group["year"].idxmin()]
    end = group.loc[group["year"].idxmax()]
    years = end["year"] - start["year"]
    rate = (end["gdpPercap"] / start["gdpPercap"]) ** (1 / years) - 1
    return pd.Series(
        {
            "start_year": start["year"],
            "end_year": end["year"],
            "gdpPercap_start": start["gdpPercap"],
            "gdpPercap_end": end["gdpPercap"],
            "cagr_pct": rate * 100,
        }
    )


growth_table = gdp_compare.groupby("country").apply(compute).reset_index()
growth_table.round(2)

title: R Analysis: GDP per Capita: Taiwan vs. Canada
text:
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

df <- read_csv("gapminder.csv")

Data: Gapminder (https://www.gapminder.org/data/), via the Software Carpentry r-novice-gapminder lesson (https://github.com/swcarpentry/r-novice-gapminder), CC BY 4.0.

gdp_compare <- df |>
  filter(country %in% c("Taiwan", "Canada")) |>
  select(country, year, gdpPercap, pop) |>
  mutate(gdp_total_billions = (gdpPercap * pop) / 1e9)
